fields.name: bgFile
documentation: Optional background texture asset.

fields.name: edgeFile
documentation: Optional edge texture asset.

fields.name: edgeSize
documentation: Optional edge size.

fields.name: insets
documentation: Optional backdrop insets.

fields.name: tile
documentation: If true, tiles the background texture.

fields.name: tileEdge
documentation: If true, tiles the edge texture.

fields.name: tileSize
documentation: Optional tile size used when tiling the background texture.

fields.name: backdropInfo
documentation: Backdrop information used to construct the tooltip backdrop.

fields.name: borderColor
documentation: Optional color applied to the backdrop border.

fields.name: centerColor
documentation: Optional color applied to the backdrop background.

fields.name: anchorOffsets
documentation: Optional offsets applied to the backdrop's TOPLEFT and BOTTOMRIGHT anchor points.

fields.name: layoutName
documentation: Name of the NineSlice layout template to apply, such as 'TooltipDefaultLayout'.

fields.name: borderColor
documentation: Optional color applied to the NineSlice border.

fields.name: centerColor
documentation: Optional color applied to the NineSlice center region.

fields.name: anchorOffsets
documentation: Optional offsets applied to the NineSlice's TOPLEFT and BOTTOMRIGHT anchor points.

fields.name: asset
documentation: Texture asset (file path or atlas name) displayed by the slice.

fields.name: sliceMargins
documentation: Optional texture slice margins. See Texture:SetTextureSliceMargins.

fields.name: sliceMode
documentation: Optional texture slice mode. See Texture:SetTextureSliceMode.

fields.name: color
documentation: Optional vertex color applied to the texture.

fields.name: anchorOffsets
documentation: Optional offsets applied to the slice's TOPLEFT and BOTTOMRIGHT anchor points.

fields.name: drawLayer
documentation: Draw layer used when displaying the texture.

fields.name: drawLayerSublevel
documentation: Draw layer sublevel used when displaying the texture.

fields.name: maxApplications
documentation: The maximum number of aura applications represented by the bar.

fields.name: minApplications
documentation: The minimum number of aura applications represented by the bar.

fields.name: interpolation
documentation: Optional interpolation method used when updating the bar value.

fields.name: formatter
documentation: Optional formatter used to display aura application counts.

fields.name: showRealmName
documentation: If true, append realm names to the displayed string.

fields.name: useClassColors
documentation: If true, apply class coloring to the text.

fields.name: showWhenHarmful
documentation: Shows the dispel type text for harmful auras.

fields.name: showWhenHelpful
documentation: Shows the dispel type text for helpful auras.

fields.name: showWithoutDispelType
documentation: Shows the dispel type text for auras that do not have a dispel type.

fields.name: customDispelTextMap
documentation: Optional map of dispel type names to custom texts. An empty key can be used for auras without a dispel type.

fields.name: asset
documentation: The texture file or atlas to use.

fields.name: useAtlasSize
documentation: Resizes the texture to the atlas dimensions. Ignored when asset does not name an atlas.

fields.name: texCoords
documentation: Optional texture coordinates used when asset does not name an atlas.

fields.name: showAlways
documentation: Shows the dispel type texture always, ignoring all other criteria.

fields.name: showWhenHarmful
documentation: Shows the dispel type texture for harmful auras.

fields.name: showWhenHelpful
documentation: Shows the dispel type texture for helpful auras.

fields.name: showWithoutDispelType
documentation: Shows the dispel type texture for auras that do not have a dispel type.

fields.name: stealableFilter
documentation: Restricts display of the dispel type texture to either stealable or non-stealable auras. If omitted, the dispel type texture may be shown for both.

fields.name: style
documentation: The texture style to use.

fields.name: customDispelAssetMap
documentation: Optional map of dispel type names to custom texture assets. The "None" key represents auras without a dispel type. Only applies when using the CustomAsset style.

fields.name: customDispelColorMap
documentation: Optional map of dispel type names to custom vertex colors. The "None" key represents auras without a dispel type.

fields.name: customDispelColorCurve
documentation: Optional curve used to determine vertex colors from the aura's dispel type.

fields.name: interpolation
documentation: The interpolation method used when updating the duration bar.

fields.name: direction
documentation: The direction in which the duration bar progresses.

fields.name: binding
documentation: Optional duration text binding to use. The binding is copied before being associated with the aura button.

fields.name: textFormatter
documentation: Optional formatter used to display remaining duration values. Ignored if textFormat is specified.

fields.name: textFormat
documentation: Optional text format configuration applied to the duration text binding. Overrides textFormatter when specified.

fields.name: textColor
documentation: Optional text color configuration applied to the duration text binding.
